lines.zh: 我四足落地，爪子抓得很实
lines.en: I go on four legs, claws gripping firm.
My mane brushes through the trees.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方草被压出一条
lines.en: The grass flattens into a path behind me.

lines.zh: 我一边走一边听着四周
lines.en: I walk and listen all around.

lines.zh: 四只爪子踩着腐叶前进。
lines.en: All four claws advance over rotting leaves.

lines.zh: 我从一段坡上下来，很稳
lines.en: I come down a slope, steady.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸在林间成白雾
lines.en: My breath makes white mist.

lines.zh: 我是成熟期的，走得比看着快
lines.en: I am a Champion; I move faster than I look.

lines.zh: 我踩在一块石头上，石头没动
lines.en: I step on a stone and it holds.

lines.zh: 我朝有声音的方向偏了偏头
lines.en: I tip my head toward a sound.

lines.zh: 我从一棵倒木上跨过去
lines.en: I step over a fallen log.
I stop and sniff the ground.
I walk toward the wood's edge.

lines.zh: 我的鬃毛上挂着几片叶
lines.en: A few leaves hang in my mane.

lines.zh: 我站在树影里，鬃毛竖着
lines.en: I stand in the tree shade, mane up.
My claws half-sheathed.
I watch the wood for movement.

lines.zh: 我慢慢把身体转了个方向
lines.en: I turn my body slowly.
My tail sweeps the dry leaves aside.

lines.zh: 我听见远处有风穿过树
lines.en: I hear wind through distant trees.
I look up; clouds move past the canopy.

lines.zh: 我把爪子按进松软的土。
lines.en: I press my claws into the soft earth.
I lift one forepaw.

lines.zh: 林子里的光斑在我身上移
lines.en: Dappled light moves over me.
I let out a long slow breath.
I curl my tail at my feet.
I hear a squirrel run in the branches.
My ears turn left.
I raise my head, my mane rising.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸喷到我的鼻尖。
lines.en: Your breath reaches my snout.

lines.zh: 我的爪子在地上按了一下
lines.en: I press a claw into the ground.
I do not know your scent.
I move, and the wood goes quiet.
I lower my forequarters a little.

lines.zh: 你身上没有黎明的味道
lines.en: You carry no scent of the dawn.
I take one slow step toward you.
My gaze is nailed to you.

lines.zh: 我的鬃毛在树影里竖起。
lines.en: My mane bristles in the tree shade.

lines.zh: 森林里，我的角擦着树枝。
lines.en: In the forest, my horns brush the branches.
You reach for your belt; I see it.
I do not like being blocked.
I lower my forequarters further.
Only two paces between us.
You have not run; I am surprised.
I give half a step, claws digging in.
My mane flattens.
A growl presses out of my throat.
My breathing grows rough.
A patch of my mane is disordered.
I crouch to guard my belly.

lines.zh: 我把爪子在地上抓出痕
lines.en: My claws score the ground.
I retreat slowly several steps.
I growl low in my throat.
One leg will not take my weight.

lines.zh: 你手里那块东西，我闻到了
lines.en: I smell what is in your hand.
I edge half a step toward it.
I am not fussy; meat will do.
Set it down; I will take it.

lines.zh: 我的爪子不安分地动着
lines.en: My claws work restlessly.
A little forward, tail sweeping the floor.

lines.zh: 我的鼻子动了动，闻得很细
lines.en: My nose works, sniffing closely.

lines.zh: 这不是我平时吃的，可我不挑
lines.en: This is not my usual food, but I am not fussy.

lines.zh: 你手里那东西别举太高
lines.en: Do not hold it so high.
One dip of my head and I have it.

lines.zh: 我先把头偏向一边，等你
lines.en: I tilt my head and wait.
The smell of it is strong.
You crash through ferns; I don't move.

lines.zh: 我的身体很实，退的半步不多
lines.en: My body is solid; I give little ground.
We burst a patch of brush apart.
I pull in my belly to clear the narrow path.
I lift a paw and leave a print.
You hit my chest and give way.

lines.zh: 我的前爪在你脚边落地
lines.en: My forepaws land by your feet.
We collide and dust rises.

lines.zh: 我一侧身，你从我肩边过去
lines.en: I turn and you pass my shoulder.
I hold all four feet and do not yield.

lines.zh: 她在树下等我，鬃毛很亮
lines.en: She waits under the tree, mane bright.

lines.zh: 我们绕着走了一圈，互相看
lines.en: We circle once, watching.
Her claws are longer than mine.

lines.zh: 我们一起朝林子深处走
lines.en: We head deeper into the wood together.

lines.zh: 她的呼吸和我的节奏差不多
lines.en: Her breathing falls in with mine.
She rests her head by my mane.

lines.zh: 我们一起趴下，尾巴挨着
lines.en: We lie down, tails touching.

lines.zh: 她替我舔了一下肩上的毛
lines.en: She licks the fur on my shoulder.

lines.zh: 我们一起看向林子那头
lines.en: We both look to the far wood.
She rises; so do I.
I lower my head and take it.
I shake it and dirt flies.
Pinned under my forepaw. Don't grab.

lines.zh: 我抬头看了一圈，没有别人
lines.en: I look around; no one else.
I drag it to the roots.

lines.zh: 我低下头，脖子伸得很长
lines.en: I lower my head, neck stretched.
I take it, my teeth steady.

lines.zh: 我把它放在两只前爪之间
lines.en: I lay it between my forepaws.
I lift my head and scan around.
I pick it up again and carry it off.
I stop, all four feet planted.
My mane rises fully.
I sink low, ready to spring.
You are still there; good.

lines.zh: 我不叫，叫了会惊走猎物
lines.en: I do not roar; it would spook the prey.

lines.zh: 我把身体压低到几乎贴地
lines.en: I sink almost to the ground.
My mane rises hair by hair.
My hind legs tense.
You are dead ahead; you cannot run.
I make no sound but breath.

lines.zh: 落叶在我脚下压出浅坑。
lines.en: Dead leaves dent under my steps.
I square my head and fix my eyes.
I circle you with light steps.

lines.zh: 你转身，我就换到另一侧
lines.en: You turn; I move to the other side.
I am patient; the wood is mine.

lines.zh: 我一步一步把距离缩掉
lines.en: Step by step I eat the distance.

lines.zh: 我的爪子在地上发出很轻的声音
lines.en: My claws click softly on the ground.

lines.zh: 我绕着你转，一圈比一圈小
lines.en: I circle you, each pass smaller.

lines.zh: 我的脚步在林子里很轻
lines.en: My steps are light in the wood.

lines.zh: 你转身找我，我在你背后
lines.en: You turn to find me; I am behind you.
I am in no hurry; I know this wood better.

lines.zh: 灌木擦着侧腹，一路过去。
lines.en: Brush scrapes my flank as I pass.

lines.zh: 你退到树边，树挡了你的路
lines.en: You back to a tree; it blocks you.
I am one step away, ready.
I spring, foreclaws first.
I bite; my teeth are hard.

lines.zh: 我整个肩撞进它的胸口。
lines.en: My whole shoulder slams into its chest.
My claws rake down from your shoulder.
I strike, withdraw, and crouch again.

lines.zh: 牙齿陷进衣料，尝到铁味。
lines.en: My teeth sink into cloth and taste iron.
My forepaws press your chest.
One charge and you slide far.
I come in from the flank.

lines.zh: 我的爪子在你手臂上留下痕
lines.en: My claws leave lines on your arm.

lines.zh: 我一击不中就翻身落地
lines.en: I miss and roll to my feet.
My teeth catch your bracer.
Something in the wood lights once.

lines.zh: 我从树后走出来，鬃毛先露
lines.en: I step out from behind the tree, mane first.

lines.zh: 我的爪子踩在落叶上，很轻
lines.en: My claws settle on the leaves, lightly.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，看向林子的另一边
lines.en: I lift my head, looking across the wood.
My breath pushes the leaves aside.

lines.zh: 我站住了，这个地方由我守
lines.en: I stop; I hold this place.
Something lights in the tree shadow.

lines.zh: 我从树后出来，四足落地
lines.en: I come from behind the tree, four feet down.
Forest light catches my mane.
I press my claws into the ground.

lines.zh: 林子的风里全是食物的味。
lines.en: The forest wind is full of food smells.
I settle in the middle of the wood.
Leaves whisper under my weight.
My mane emerges from the tree shadow first.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的鬃毛，我甩开
lines.en: Fire catches my mane and I shake it off.

lines.zh: 我从坡上滚下，爪子乱抓
lines.en: I roll down the slope, claws scrabbling.

lines.zh: 水到了我的背，我拼命划
lines.en: Water reaches my back and I paddle hard.
The blast slams me into a trunk.

lines.zh: 一根木刺卡在肋间的鬃毛。
lines.en: A splinter lodges in the mane at my ribs.

lines.zh: 那股力量钻进我的身体，很乱
lines.en: That force enters me and churns.

lines.zh: 饿了很久，我的步子变虚
lines.en: Long hungry, my steps go light.

lines.zh: 雷打在我的背上，鬃毛全竖了
lines.en: Lightning strikes my back and my mane stands.

lines.zh: 脚下没有林子了，我一直落
lines.en: No woods underfoot; I fall and fall.
